note: Adapted from the English species-level description in Hill (1942); the original describes the alate and the soldier, and lists the worker only as a morphotype without describing it. The original gives a single set of soldier measurements, without a range, presumably from one specimen. OCR problems: "f ran" is from; "Fon-tanelle" is Fontanelle; "AT." is M.; "M. Kalgoorliensis" has the specific epithet capitalised in the original; "Ist" is 1st; "pi." is pl.; "frcm" is from. The type locality, Northern Territory: Stapleton, agrees with the checklist. Distribution and biology (two alates, one soldier and two workers taken near the ground on the wall of a Coptotermes acinaciformis nest; several other alates taken at light indoors on 30 September, month 9) have not been translated into the morphology sections.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: At first sight the alate resembles M. sunteri (the combination used in the original), but it is slightly darker above, distinctly darker below, the compound eyes are usually smaller, and the pronotum is much smaller and differently shaped. The soldier is closest to Lophotermes septentrionalis and differs chiefly in the small, narrow labrum with undeveloped anterolateral angles.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Compound eyes small, not distinctly projecting. Ocelli broadly oval (length 0.10 mm), separated from the compound eye by about their short diameter. Frontal line linear, without secondary splits, about as long as the ocellus. Postclypeus slightly less than half as long as wide (0.18 mm × 0.47 mm). Mandibles as in M. kalgoorliensis (the combination used in the original). Antennae 15-segmented; segment 2 about half of segment 1; segment 3 very short and narrow; segment 4 about as large as segment 6. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin concave, posterior margin slightly wavy. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum deeply concave. Media unbranched; cubitus with 8 branches, 1—2 of which branch again. Remnant petiole of the fore wing slightly larger than that of the hind wing. Measurements: length with wings 10.00 mm, length without wings 5.00—5.25 mm, head length (to apex of labrum) 1.00—1.17 mm, head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.62—0.65 mm, head width 0.91—0.99 mm, greatest diameter of compound eye 0.25 mm, ocellus length 0.10 mm, pronotum length 0.58 mm, width 0.82—0.88 mm, fore wing length 8.40—8.60 mm, width 2.16—2.20 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Closest to Lophotermes septentrionalis, with a similar head shape, but the labrum small and narrow with weak anterolateral angles; antennae 14-segmented. Measurements: head length (to apex of frontal tubercle) 1.90 mm, head width 1.24 mm, pronotum length 0.33 mm, width 0.84 mm.
